summary_1line: Krishna praises Shiva as the supreme reality; Shiva and Uma, pleased, grant Krishna numerous boons including power, devotion, prosperity, and many sons and wives.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna bows before Shiva and Uma as celestial flowers rain down and gods, sages, and spirits gather around in reverence.
Shiva, radiant beside the goddess Uma, offers Krishna eight boons while the assembled universe watches in awe.
Showers of fragrant celestial flowers fall upon Krishna as winds blow softly and the gathered deities bow to Shiva.
